title: Combat Simulator 2.8.1.6
changes: Improved Dynamic Camera framing and close-up angle consistency.
Reduced enemy grab latency and limited unnatural wrist rotation.
Reworked optional hair physics with continuous simulation and improved face-side collisions.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.1.5
changes: Added an Armor Detachment profile.
Adjusted weapon physics.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.1.4
changes: Fixed Armor Detachment reverting Glamourer outfits during redraws.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.1.3
changes: Expanded Virtual Enemy variants with their correct equipment, weapons, and authored appearances.
Added NPC visual scaling with consistent absolute sizing for oversized and undersized enemies.
Added enemy attack-range scaling that also adjusts chase and formation stopping distances.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.1.2
changes: Fixed mismatched Virtual Enemy search results, models, and attacks.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.1.1
changes: Expanded Virtual Enemy search to include linked model variants that were previously omitted.
Improved DemiHuman and Monster combat with broader model-family attack timelines and correctly matched attack, impact, and projectile VFX.
Prevented unrelated generic effects from replacing model-specific or intentionally effect-free timeline visuals.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.1.0
changes: Overhauled Virtual Enemies with a much broader Human, DemiHuman, and Monster catalog, improved search, and corrected name-to-model pairing. Special thanks to miqote69 and ActorMorpher for the valuable reference.
Improved creature combat with preserved DemiHuman weapon identities, model-specific attack animations, and richer hit VFX.
Improved physical presentation with per-leg ground contact and more stable Armor Detachment behavior, including better detached-trouser deformation and cleanup.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.0.2
changes: General improvements.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.0.1
changes: Minor improvements.
Allow stepping on settled ragdolls.

title: Combat Simulator 2.8.0.0
changes: Added Enemy Control. Enable it under Effects > Enemy Control.
Major improvements to ragdoll physics, fixing rigid, unnatural leg and knee bending when a body collapses.

title: Combat Simulator 2.7.2.0
changes: Human enemies now cast real job-based skills from their weapon.
Added the experimental Spectators crowd with reactive chatter.
Added independent glove and boot armor detachment.
Replaced Death Cam with the Dynamic Camera.
Improved ragdoll joint stability and fixed several crashes.

title: Combat Simulator 2.7.1.2
changes: For safety, experimental features are no longer included in release builds. These options were normally not something regular users could enable, so this change can be safely ignored.

title: Combat Simulator 2.7.1.1
changes: Improved performance: NPC collision now defaults to the lighter convex hull shape.
Added stuttering warnings to the NPC collision shape and Extend Terrain Detection options.

title: Combat Simulator 2.7.1.0
changes: Added the experimental Dynamic Camera feature.
Improved ragdoll physics and stability.
Improved Armor Detachment.
Fixed several logout, cleanup, and render-related crashes.
Improved overall plugin stability.

title: Combat Simulator 2.7.0.1
changes: Added BEPU-based hair physics for ragdolls.
Added tuning options for visual-only cloth detachment.
Added an option to spawn virtual enemies directly in front of the player.
Fixed several ragdoll and dismemberment crash issues.
Improved overall stability for public builds.

title: Combat Simulator 2.7.0.0
changes: Added an experimental cloth tube physics model for Armor Detachment (Body and Legs) — garments now wrap the body and slide down naturally instead of folding.
Added tube tuning options (friction, handoff delay), a debug wireframe, and a new Visual Only cloth hold profile.
Improved Advanced Clothing Settle stability, with less deformation on physics handoff and per-segment coat skirt draping.
NPC ragdolls can now collide with and rest on skinned meshes such as mounts and other characters.
Fixed mounted-death dismemberment being enabled by default.

title: Combat Simulator 2.6.0.2
changes: Improved plugin security.
Camera and combat recipe selections are now remembered between sessions.

title: Combat Simulator 2.6.0.1
changes: Disable Fighting Mode due to security concerns.

title: Combat Simulator 2.6.0.0
changes: Added the Armor Detachment control window under Professional Mode > Effects.
Added Fighting Mode (experimental).
Improved ragdoll physics tuning and stability overall.
